content: आनन्दमय {%a.%} Blissful, full of joy, made up or consisting of happiness; सुषुप्तिस्थान एकीभूतः प्रज्ञानघन एवानन्दमयो ह्यानन्दभुक् <ls>Māṇḍ. 5</ls>. .{@-यः@} The Supreme Spirit; <ls>Br. Sūt. 1. 1. 12</ls>. .{@-यी@} A form of Durgā. {@˚कोशः@} the innermost wrapper or vesture of the body, causal frame enshrining the soul; see कोश.
